episode.showDescription: The official podcast of comedian Joe Rogan.
episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

transcript_window.text: I was just so mind blown.
And it really was frustrating because it's not even did it not exist.
No one really seemed to even think it needed to exist.
I was like, you guys, these are kids.
You have no issue making billions of dollars in profit on little kids working on the farms.
It was like a very weird thing.
That's crazy.
So that's most chocolate?
Well, majority of the world's cacao, as you saw, comes from West Africa.
Holy shit, man.
Yeah, I know.
And so that's what I mean.
I'm thousands of hours deep into this.
And so I met a different company called Tony's Chocolony, who is like a reporter who started talking about this.
Wait a minute.
His name is Chocolony?
Tony.
But the chocolate brand is Tony's Chocolony.
They did ethical sourcing.
And I spent a lot of time learning from them.
And I've just been on this journey with Feastables.
It's how can we ethically source Feastables cacao?
And so we actually – this is a fun thing I've never said publicly.
So we started doing – working with certain farms.
But then I started around seven months ago, a big case study where we went to five villages that the average child labor there was like 45 percent.
So 45 percent of the labor on the farms in these villages was illegal child labor.
